title: Zesty Norwegian Brown Rice Noodle Bowl
description: A fatty, crunchy meal-prep bowl made with blanched brown rice noodles, zesty lemon-soy dressing, and toasted nuts and seeds for a Mediterranean-friendly Norwegian twist.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and blanch brown rice noodles for 3 minutes.
Drain the noodles and rinse them under cold water to stop the cooking process.
Whisk together olive oil, sesame oil, lemon juice, light soy sauce, minced garlic, and red pepper flakes in a small bowl.
Toss the blanched noodles with the dressing until evenly coated.
Stir in chopped parsley and season with a pinch of salt.
Transfer the noodle mixture to a large airtight container for meal prep.
Toast walnuts in a dry skillet over medium heat for 4 minutes, shaking frequently until fragrant.
Toast sunflower seeds in the same skillet for 2 minutes, stirring to prevent burning.
Store toasted nuts and seeds in a separate airtight container.
When ready to serve, divide the noodle bowl into portions and top each with toasted walnuts and sunflower seeds, optionally squeezing fresh lemon juice on top.
